The most common shell type that causes damage only when it penetrates a vehicle's armor. The shell can ricochet if it hits the armor at an angle. The penetration power of Armor-Piercing shells decreases with distance traveled.

The Chinese boast a fine-tuned ring of agents that helps them adopt the latest practices in tank building. The chance to test that new hardware under the extreme conditions of Steel Hunter is a real treat for their engineers.

Lightness, smooth shapes, and grace are the three pillars that determine French tank-building. Neither borrowed designs nor technologies obtained through industrial espionage were the basis of this vehicle. It boasts only original, effective ideas and solutions.

The Germans are old hands at both metallurgical engineering and high-quality assembly. This vehicle is the perfect lone wolf: independent, versatile, and easily capable of adapting to any combat situation to survive.

Polish engineers know that emphasizing one of a vehicle's strong suits automatically results in the deterioration of another characteristic. That's why they gave enough consideration to the vehicle's armament and combat abilities to prevent the enemy from seeking out its weak spots. As time would tell, that proved to be the right decision.

The Swedes have never overlooked new trends in tank building, and joining Steel Hunter gave their best engineers free rein. This vehicle brings together their riskiest and most ingenious ideas. It can both deal and take heavy blows, and that seems to work just fine.

British engineers continue to show how they build perfect vehicles that attract experienced commanders and terrify enemies, and this hunter is no exception. Its legendary British steel is ready to demonstrate its supremacy on the battlefield once again.

This vehicle perfectly balances modern and classic. Time-tested technologies combined with the latest advancements served as the basis for this tank, which is a true pleasure to drive—so long as you don't mind rusty metal, of course.

This tank, assembled from written-off parts and components from various tank-building factories, poses a serious threat to any enemy vehicle. A real monster can be created right on the battlefield by tossing blueprints and technical documentation to the wind.

Commander Jack "Lumberjack" Thompson, a rugged lumberman from the American Pacific Northwest, is known for his sharp ax. He transitioned from felling trees to commanding tanks, applying his strategic thinking on how to knock things down to the battlefield. His strength and understanding of terrain and machinery make him a formidable opponent in World of Tanks.

A well-known Czech content creator and frequent tournament caster, Marty_Vole is now ready to conquer the battlefield as a Commander. Whether you're a fan of his streams or just need a Commander who'll provide some extra flair in battle, one thing is for sure: with his trademark insight, analysis, and in-depth knowledge of all things WoT, you won't regret putting Marty_Vole in charge of your vehicle's crew!

Sure, Claudia may occasionally sleep a little before an important battle, but one thing's for sure—on the battlefield, you won't catch her napping. Cunning and crafty by nature, she's a master of strategy, happy to play the waiting game before striking from cover at just the right moment. No matter how heated things get in battle, Claudia's natural grace and composure mean she always manages to land on her feet.

Donny is daring, determined, and likes to dive into the heat of battle head first. After all, why waste time sitting around when there's fun to be had? While his dynamism and eagerness to impress may not always bring the desired results, Donny's bold battle style means he fears no enemy—not even in the most intense of situations. Even when it can feel like all is lost, Donny might just come in clutch.

What's the matter? Never seen a shredded mouse before? Despite boasting impressive guns, Markus prefers to try and find a diplomatic solution where possible. He's not a fan of brute force, but if push comes to shove—say, he needs to use his considerable size to protect an ally—then he's ready to do what it takes. And if there's cheese at stake, then this mouse isn't going to go quietly.

Give a tanker a hot dog, and he'll eat for a day. Give Todd Jefferson a grill, and he'll make enough hot dogs to feed a whole unit for a month. The garage's most senior engineer, Todd felt a sense of paternal duty toward its younger recruits, and took it upon himself to make sure they felt at home from day one. Typically, that involved plying them with grilled meat at impromptu welcome barbecues. An anniversary road trip, therefore, presented the perfect opportunity to indulge in the two things that brought him the most joy: firing up engines by day, then firing up his portable grill by night.

When the garage whistle blew and the mechanics traipsed homeward after a long shift, Bobby Ray always had other plans. The din of heavy machinery still ringing in his ears and a roguish smile on his face, he would bolt from the factory floor, grab his guitar from his locker, and make a beeline for the all-night rock 'n' roll club. So when his colleagues proposed a road trip to celebrate 16 years of tanking, there was no way Bobby wouldn't be providing the soundtrack; he'd tested countless weapons in his time, but he'd never found one as deadly as his trusty archtop semi-acoustic.

Rosie Burns's garage colleagues swore by two credos: if it ain't broke, don't fix it; and if it is broke, then call Rosie. A high school baseball star turned tank mechanic extraordinaire, she enjoyed nothing more than rolling her sleeves up and solving the problems that had everyone else stumped. That knack for fixing the unfixable made her the perfect companion for an anniversary tanking trip: this was a woman who knew how to keep engines running, tracks rolling, and spirits high. No matter what curveballs the journey might throw, you could rely on Rosie to have all bases covered.

As a boy, Emrah was fascinated by the connections between shadows and the world around him. Driven by his thirst for knowledge and a budding talent for alchemy, he left his family in Turkey to explore the unknown. Along the way, he joined a group of nomadic magicians and sorcerers—and witnessed dark, otherworldly threats.
Through rigorous training and experimentation, he mastered the art of combining alchemy with the power of metals, before joining a specialized army to fight enemies from other worlds. Now, as a commander, he protects his world from the encroaching darkness.

Don't let her poise and elegance fool you: Adelais is a battle-hardened fencing champion with thousands of duels to her name. Confident, focused, and graceful on the piste, she's armed with lightning-fast reflexes and a riposte for any situation. Yet when she's not putting opponents to the sword, she can be found commanding the battlefield—where she brings the same deadly precision. You might think you're quick, but Adelais is quicker. Now...en garde!

Never seen without his trusty hound Winston by his side, William has dedicated his life to the art of hunting. Captivated by the wonders of the forest during childhood outings with his father, he has donned his tweed cap and shooting jacket without fail every day since—come rain or shine. Affable and avuncular when he's not tracking his prey, William is a seasoned marksman with an unerring shot. His hunter's instinct translates seamlessly to tank battles—and once he has a target in his sights, his eagle-eyed focus ensures he never misses the mark.

She's a determined and headstrong lady. In her childhood, she learned the specifics of tank combat from her father. However, later on, she followed in her mother's footsteps and studied medicine. After graduating from the Academy, she had a good track record in field hospitals but insisted on transferring to a tank unit where she hopes to realize her full potential as a tank commander.

An experienced commander who's always cool and calculating. During his 20 years of service, he's braved many challenges, earning his own command while receiving the respect of his comrades-in-arms. He likes to win with honor, keep strict discipline, and comply with the rules of engagement. Due to its outstanding performance, Kilmore's platoon is something of a legend. As an avid surfer, he keeps his surfboard nearby as a good luck charm.
Was awarded for fulfilling particular conditions during the Tank football 2018 event. Italian legend Gianluigi Buffon is a Commander with a unique voiceover and perks trained to 100%.
Selected as compensation for changed shell characteristics. This crew member has the Brothers in Arms perk trained to 100%.

Wherever he finds himself, Damien Touttée is always ready to cook up a storm. For this culinary daredevil and tanking virtuoso, the battlefield, like the kitchen, is about expression. A dash of salt here, the blast of an HE shell there; these are the touches—sometimes subtle, sometimes less so—that make up his chefs-d'œuvre. Even when the ingredients are limited, the possibilities are endless for those bold enough to experiment. Give Damien a camp stove, and he'll make a feast. Give him an enemy tank, and he'll make a heap of scrap metal. Just let him cook.

The spoiled offspring of European aristocrats, the Baroness graduated from student radicalism and eventually joined the ranks of COBRA. Her chief strength in navigating the organization's power structure is in playing high-ranking members against each other. Rumor has it she is also the only person who knows Destro's true identity.

Ah, here we go again. Another day, another poor soul, another few coins in my pocket. Everyone wants to challenge the Gunslinger. Everyone wants to be king of the hill. Just look me in the eye—you're doomed, boy. Turn around, and walk on home while you still can. Hm, thought so. Your call. One step, two steps, three steps... Draw!
Like in the old sagas, this warrior has gone viking, but now he rides a drakkar of steel, wielding a gun instead of an axe.

A tanker who fights on impulse more than not, and has been with the tank unit since he was a young boy. However, average theory knowledge does not prevent him from defeating enemies in any combat situation. Disposition: difficult, impulsive. Known for his unconventional tactical thinking, which gives him an advantage on the battlefield.

Graduated from the Royal Armored Academy with honors, the best cadet in his class. He was an excellent shooter and set the school record for destroying moving targets from a long distance. He has vast knowledge of the specifications of most modern vehicles and takes advantage of them in battles. Disposition: calm, balanced. No disciplinary punishments.

A talented female commander who lives up to her name with her passion and joy of battle. Getting her way at all costs, commanding people, and always leading the charge are the three pillars that determine her battle tactics.
Cobra Commander is the leader of Cobra, an evil organization determined to rule the world. Cobra's goal is to defeat G.I. Joe and destroy some enemy tanks along the way.

Cover Girl was initially a high fashion model in New York and Chicago who enlisted in the service, attended Armor School at Fort Knox and related technology schools, and is an expert at diesel mechanics and gas turbine technology.
A real hero, Duke is the leader of the G.I. Joe team and he's ready to take on his enemies in the name of peace and freedom.

A tank battle is a lot like a football match. You start out neat and cautious, studying your opponents. You take the position that suits your role. You fall back if your teammates need your help. But most importantly, you're always alert, waiting for a chance to strike… And when it's there, all you need is a good shot.
"Orbiting Earth in the spaceship, I saw how beautiful our planet is. People, let us preserve and increase this beauty, not destroy it!"

I'm a big rugby fan, you know. And the minute they brought me here, I immediately felt like a fish in water. I mean, think about it. 15-on-15 scrums? Check. Different roles on the field? Check. Tactical variety? Check. Power moves? Loads of them! Too bad there's no referee—the lads here do some really crazy stuff sometimes. So I'll just take a couple more fights and head back to my place, if you don't mind, mate.

Knabe is a force to be reckoned with. He once pulled five tanks out of the mud with his bare hands and hardly broke a sweat! As a tank commander, he leads his team to victory—even if the team actively resists.
The embodiment of sheer power and a role model for girls around the globe, she's got an unbreakable body and spirit.
No matter what vehicle she controls, Marie LeGrand is a true menace who leads her crew to dominance in battle.

Life, to me, is the greatest of all games. The danger lies in treating it as a trivial game, a game to be taken lightly, and a game in which the rules don't matter much. The rules matter a great deal. The game has to be played fairly, or it is no game at all. Have you not succeeded? Continue! Have you succeeded? Continue! The time to prepare for your next expedition is when you have just returned from a successful trip.

*Based on quotes by Ernest Shackleton, Fridtjof Nansen, and Robert Peary.
Just as we're saying farewell to a messed up 2020, Omelia Hayworth is joining the ranks of World of Tanks commanders, bringing joy and a true holiday spirit. Here's to a happy 2021!

Having a devout heart and a tactician's mind, Palatine Patricia Laserian is a distinguished combatant even among the members of Adepta Sororitas. Her maxim is: "Your training will help you aim the blow, but your faith will make it decisive".
He may trick, he may treat. He won't stand for defeat. As a tanker, he's notorious. His sole goal—to be victorious!

QuickyBaby has been a passionate World of Tanks commander since the early days of the game. It's time for the famed content creator to join you in your Garage and lead you to victory!
His analytical approach to the game and quick wit have earned him an ever-growing community on Twitch and YouTube and make him an excellent commander on the battlefield. Roll out together, wreak havoc, and show your enemies why QuickyBaby still has a great love for the game after all these years.
A brave commander perfectly skilled in the art of tank combat. In his spare time, he studies enemy tactics or plays chess. He does not lose his temper even in the most stressful of situations.

Her name speaks for itself. A spotless soul with the purest of intentions and a killer look (literally!). And what a shock it is to realize how different the business of protecting everyone is when you're behind the scenes.

A Primaris Space Marine, Lieutenant Tolmeron is not as venerable as some veterans of his famed Chapter, but he already has their respect. He is considered to be a bellicose exemplar of justice with unwavering loyalty to his battle brothers. The humility with which he accepts promotions and decorations—and, most of all, the ease with which he earns them—is notable. "In combat, he moves like a drop of blood sliding down an adamantium plate: quickly, inevitably," say the brethren. "The blood of Sanguinius runs noble in this one. And his battle scars adorn him."

In a way that befits a ninjutsu master, Splinter’s origins are shrouded in mystery. A man who turned into a humanoid rat, or an evolved rodent—yet does it really matter? We all know him as a great warrior, a wise sensei, and a genuinely good person: a loving father to four adoptive sons.

A talented junior researcher, Ermelinda's input was crucial for the development of automated tracked sentry units for a hi-tech prototype. To test the units' pathfinding and targeting, she fought them in various tanks. Thus the promising physicist also became a tank commander.

Hidden by shadows
She is right in front of you

"Raise your tankards high, me hearties, for today we've danced with the tempest and plundered the spoils of the sea! Let our deeds echo through the winds, for we be the scourge of the ocean, striking fear into the hearts of men! But remember this, me mates: it's not just the strength of our blades that makes us fearsome, but the unyielding spirit that burns within our souls. Aye, we be the masters of our own fate, and as long as the tide flows, our names shall forever be whispered in awe and trepidation upon the seven seas!"

Be it a starship brimming with advanced technology or an antique tracked vehicle with an internal combustion engine, James T. Kirk is a master of bold moves and unorthodox solutions. His charisma—especially when he’s in the commander’s chair—motivates his crew to succeed against improbable odds.

While he is not a physicist (or a bricklayer), Leonard "Bones" McCoy is an accomplished physician and a dedicated crew member who can be trusted to ably fulfill any role. Despite his acerbic streak, the good doctor is a crewmate who can always be relied on. He is quite comfortable in any planet-bound tracked vehicle, far from the darkness and silence of space—and the nasty effects of aviophobia.

Montgomery "Scotty" Scott is able to perform any function capably, but he is first and foremost an engineer—or, rather, the engineer: the epitome, the archetype. This is due to his deep understanding of theoretical physics, combined with a pragmatic resourcefulness and a genuine care for his "wee bairns", be they warp cores or his fellow crew members.

Commanding officer, first mate, chief scientist—irrespective of his position, Spock is a specialist of exemplary efficiency. His composure even during red alerts, coupled with a strong sense of duty and unwavering loyalty to his shipmates, make Spock an invaluable member of any crew fortunate enough to have him.
An exemplary helmsman, Hikaru Sulu also excels at fencing and skydiving from orbit. Because he’s so modest, it’s impossible to guess how long the full list of his skills is.

A child prodigy who blossomed into an outstanding linguistics and communications specialist, Nyota Uhura also demonstrates impressive command skills thanks to her natural eloquence. She is able to establish a perfect understanding with any crew and contribute to the success of any enterprise.
Awarded during particular game events. Female crew members have the Brothers in Arms perk trained to 100%, as well as one more perk of your choice trained to 100%.

Many brave tankers fought for the British Army's 7th Armoured Division in the famous North Africa campaign that won them the affectionate nickname "Desert Rats". But none earned that name quite like Len Burrows, the soft-spoken English ace who would lead days-long assaults on enemy positions with no sleep and come back with barely a bolt loose on his tank. It was as if he were born for the dunes: the blistering heat seemed to focus his mind, the incessant sandstorms to sharpen his aim. In the heat of those desert clashes, under the blazing sun, Len blazed his own trail of glory.

Grew up where the air's thick enough to chew, and the gators are always watchin' your every move. My old man taught me to cast a line 'fore I could read, and I spent most my days on his beat-up boat, pullin' bass and catfish from waters full o' teeth. Ain't much room for fear out there, I tell ya. Now they got me drivin' a steel beast instead, and truth be told, it ain't all that different. Still takes steady hands, sharp eyes, and nerves tough as ol' leather. I ain't no hero, mind. Just a swamp man doin' his part, same as always.

Name's Marshall Gunn—frontman turned tank commander. I lit up stages, burned bridges, and woke up in warzones long before I ever saw a battlefield. Lived hard and crashed harder until life on the road damn near swallowed me whole. When the band split and the music faded, I swapped my six-string for sixty tons of heavy metal. No more cheering crowds or sold-out stadiums—just mayhem and smoke, followed by a silence that's loud enough to drown out the demons of my past. If the devil wants his due, he knows exactly where to find me.

A little short in stature as well as temper, this high-strung Vice-Commander considers intelligence-gathering on rival teams her favorite tactic. She has no qualms about bending the rules of Sensha-Dō if it means securing victory. So much so that she often gets chewed out by Kei when she gets caught.
Ambitious and hard-working, Caesar carries out her duties as loader with imperial diligence.
A tank warfare pro, Erwin commands Team-Kabasan with unwavering resolve.

With her extraverted personality and impeccable sense of fair play, Kei is the playful yet skilled commander of Saunders University High School's Sensha-Dō team. She is the spiritual pillar of the team, and helps her teammates remember that victory tastes sweeter when it's served with a generous helping of fun.

This gum-chewing sharpshooter is too cool for school... unless, of course, that school has a Sensha-Dō team! Naomi may be calmer and more introverted than some of her teammates, but her skill with a gun is an immense threat to any opponent.
Oryo is a calm, collected driver inspired by the noble heritage of restoration Japan.
Gunner Saemonza channels the samurai spirit, striking swiftly and decisively on the battlefield.

A member of the Saunders Sensha-Dō team who usually operates in the M4A1 Sherman, commanded by Alisa. She's low-key getting tired of being caught in the crossfire of Alisa's occasional outbursts—and sitting through her rants about her frequent heartbreaks.

This crew member has enough experience to train three perks of your choice to 100%.

Few can boast such a track record and this number of awards. However, his comrades note that he is a very controversial person. On the one hand, he is a professional the likes of which you'll never meet. On the other, he is a very hard person to talk to. His methods can cause total confusion but they are always effective.
Participate in the Mirny: Hope event.

During his years of service in the armored corps, he turned into a seasoned veteran who his glorious ancestors would be proud of. In training, he primarily relies on his extensive experience instead of impartial paragraphs from textbooks.
Participate in the Mirny: Hope event.

Having been in many conflict zones, he managed not to lose his kindness, nor his sense of humor, and become a father for young soldiers. His wit, intuition, and a sense of duty often helped him out of seemingly desperate situations, and now Lopakhin shares his knowledge with the cadets.
Participate in the Mirny: Hope event.

A very valuable specialist, who has a huge number of tank battles with various opponents behind his back. He is irreplaceable when training new personnel. He believes that the best award for a soldier is not another government medal, but a successfully completed mission with minimal losses.
Participate in the Mirny: Hope event.

Pet him without permission, and you risk easily losing an arm. Caudamius considers himself a wild cat who came to humans of his own volition and now lives among them as equals. Thanks to his tough character, he does a great job as the radio operator for his crew of witches. In fact, his hearing alone can detect enemies at vast distances.

After graduating from the magic academy, Aurelia von Alden surprised everyone by deciding not to return to her ancestral home. Instead, she set off to join the crew of the legendary Hammer tank and protect the world against otherworldly threats. Still, this witch tank loader is perfectly prim and proper, and, of course, always punctual.

As a young witch, Deirdre suffered the early loss of her mother. She was then raised by her father, the famous master Holgrim the Iron, designer of the legendary Hammer witch tank. Dei loves machines, speed, and cookies. Her cheerful and active nature helps her to get out of extremely difficult combat situations, while always managing to boost the morale of the entire crew.

After starting her tour of duty as a driver in the tank forces, Cordelia Astra's leadership qualities quickly propelled her into the position of commander. As a seasoned veteran of numerous military campaigns, Cordelia is responsible, calm, and tough-minded. To Cordelia, her tank crew is her family, and she will never abandon her family, no matter the situation.

Impulsive and explosive, this fire witch hates all things boring and mundane. As the youngest member of the crew, she is loved and cared for, and her antics often go unpunished. In battle, however, Sybill's hot-headedness plays an important role that makes her a vital part of the crew.

Norman was never exactly known for his conversation skills, and prolonged exposure to Mirium made him even more taciturn. Nevertheless, his dedication to his duty is unwavering, and he's helped his Squad out of tough situations on more than one occasion.

Robert is a seasoned veteran whose entire existence has become intertwined with exploration of the Mirium subspace. Despite the clear risks the matter poses to his and his Squad's health, he can no longer imagine life without regular forays into ever-deeper phases.

Despite the Mirium-induced horrors he has witnessed as part of the Recon Squad, Pyotr remains a calming influence and a father figure for younger troops. Extensive contact with the matter may have forced him to recuperate for a while, but it didn't dampen his spirit and his good nature.

Elias' normally sharp wit and quick thinking may have been blunted somewhat after spending too long in the Mirium subspace, but after a rehabilitation period he's ready to venture back into its depths—and his vast experience and calmness under pressure mean he remains invaluable to his Squad.
作为首席战术研究员，大坤在巴比伦事件中凭借战场动态预判能力带领小队突围。其随身携带的改造版“实验记录仪”可实时解析敌方弱点，并通过加密频道向车组播报战术指令。因长期接触异常能量体，其听觉神经变异获得声波成像能力，能穿透战场迷雾标记高危目标，但代价是间歇性幻听——表现为突然插入冷笑话的广播杂讯。
作为同盟组织的精英坦克手，陆军在巴比伦銤元素污染灾难中幸存，成为少数未被完全腐化的“人类火炬”。他凭借顶尖的战场直觉和个人号召力，带领小队突破次元裂隙，对抗被銤元素同化的怪物坦克。

Operative Mailand returns from thrilling encounters within Mirium-infused steel beasts, overcoming each challenge with precise German accuracy. Equipped with strategic insights and battle-tested techniques, he's ready to share his expert tips and help you become a top-tier tanker. Join Mailand to refine your tactics and take down the opposition!

Operative mouzAkrobat has faced some mysterious dangers over his journey to the Babylon anomaly. Now armed with valuable and unique tactical skills and battle-honed experience, this German commander returns to guide you toward absolute dominance on the battlefield. Elevate your tanking skills to new heights with mouzAkrobat!
他在混乱中始终保持古井不波的战术心态，当队友因未知恐惧陷入慌乱时，他总能以“换个角度看战局，废墟里也能找掩体”的从容话术稳定军心，其丰富的实战经验与大口径坦克信仰，使他在战斗中屡次以极限操作逆转战局。

Operative QuickyBaby survived the mysterious forces of Mirium and emerged stronger than ever as a true hero. Armed with firsthand insights and battle-proven wisdom, he leads the charge, showing exactly what it takes to become a formidable tank commander. Join him to sharpen your skills and dominate the battlefield!

Operative Skill4ltu has completed several missions deep within the Mirium subspace, having faced its most challenging threats without flinching. Now he's back—armed with invaluable battlefield insights and refined tactical wisdom—and ready to share his expertise to help you become a truly unstoppable commander. With Skill4ltu at your side, the road to victory is yours to pave!
作为前线战术指挥官，她凭借硬核实力和天生的战场直觉，驾驶坦克为队友撤离断后，并在銤元素污染中幸存。当巴比伦次元裂隙扩大，她将带领小队深入污染区，成为首批深入污染区的女车长。

Not many people know this, but when Santa’s got too much on his plate, he sometimes outsources certain important jobs to his extended family. His nephew, John, is the head of the family tank division. Unlike his uncle, John shuns the limelight, preferring instead to work behind the scenes with his crack team of delivery elves. They tell him some tankers have been naughty this year, but John knows that, really, everyone’s been nice. So when the snow begins to fall and the Holiday Ops Village lights up, it's John Christmas's time to shine.

A natural commander, Jin Guiying carries herself with unwavering authority, yet she never lets it get in the way of building strong camaraderie among her crew. Never one to sit still for long, she feels most at home in the field, where her sharp eye for terrain and talent for practical tactics are put to full use. Lively and quick-witted, she meets every challenge with an infectious energy that keeps morale high.
"Any of you players feel sad, and I swear I'll congratulate every last one of you!"

The lead singer, guitar player, and songwriter is a modern-day Renaissance Man! He has a Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, makes Gringo Bandito Hot Sauce, and he is a real-life jet pilot! The rest of the crew remains uncertain whether those aircraft skills will transfer to an intense tank battle though.

The band's drummer. Dozing off to his metronome may prove hazardous to health. Tick-tock-tick-bang! Tick-tock-tick-blam! However, when driving, he makes no sudden moves. Any break in rhythm is considered incompetence for a drummer.

The lead guitarist attacks his instrument with a mixture of anger, sheer joy, and reckless abandon. As with every great guitarist and gunner, Noodles knows you have to take chances and give it 100% in order to hit just the right notes.

The bass guitarist who skillfully and passionately both loads shells and immerses thousands of fans in a breathtaking atmosphere during the performance. His endless positive energy and punk vibes raise the morale of the entire crew to the highest level.

Previously a history teacher in a rural Polish school, Jan answered his country's call to fight back against overwhelming firepower dominance. His fearless leadership on the battlefield, combined with his authoritative beard, led crewmates to nickname him "Chief".

Growing up in an influential Swedish military family, Anna was fascinated by blueprints, plans, and prototypes from a young age. After building on her childhood curiosity by studying tank engineering, she now applies her expertise to test high-precision combat equipment—to the great pride of her father.

Disillusioned with his studies at an elite art school, Damon rebelled by dropping out to serve Queen and country in the British Armed Forces. Swapping the fine arts for the art of war, he finally discovered his true passion—leaving his oil masterpieces on the battlefield.

As an ink master at a Florida tattoo parlor, Andy gained a reputation for being able to talk for hours with anyone about anything. After he enlisted in the military, Andy's infectious charisma found an even more receptive audience, with his natural ability to unite fellow tankers making him the "Soul" of his crew.

Hailing from the bayous of Louisiana, Captain Elijah "Gator" Brooks earned his nickname for his ability to survive and thrive in the toughest of conditions. Growing up near treacherous swamps where few dared to tread, he learned to adapt to any terrain and turn the environment to his advantage—making him a master of battlefield strategy.

A Dortmund native, Franz "Forge" Köhler is known for his unshakable focus under fire. A former factory worker used to handling heavy metal, he boasts uncanny strength and precision. He approaches targets like machines to dismantle—calculating every move with methodical accuracy—while his shots strike like a hammer on an anvil.

As a young delivery boy in the riverlands of Guangdong, Zhang "Courier" Wei often found himself sent on long-distance errands to far-off towns. Racing his trusty bicycle across vast plains and weaving through bustling city streets, he developed sharp spatial awareness and lightning-fast reactions—skills he now uses to outwit danger with every turn on the battlefield.

Background details remain sparse. Reports suggest previous service in [CLASSIFIED]. Known for unmatched speed and dexterity, "Phantom" handles ammunition like a second heartbeat. The ever-present bandana obscures more than a face—it shields secrets no one dares uncover.

Aleksander lives life in constant motion: running to the limit, swimming through cold, pushing through obstacles. His approach on the battlefield is no different; a Pole by blood and character, he will lead the charge until his strength gives out. For as long as he can remember, he has had a habit of taking machines apart to see what’s inside, and an uncanny ability to turn heaps of metal into functioning systems. With front-line discipline and a mechanic's meticulousness, he checks every part of every vehicle, knowing that the life of the crew and the next meter of progress depend on it.

A dangerous sniper with a keen eye, Natalia keeps the bigger picture in mind even when her sights are trained on her target. Her prodigious vision, though, extends beyond just marksmanship. To the constant amazement of her crewmates, she reads people intuitively, senses their intentions, and manages to make the right choice before others realize there was one to be made. Decisive, brave, and usually silent, she enters combat without a word, but with a relentless focus on the task at hand.

A lover of sleep, Aleš can doze just about anywhere: on a dugout floor, on his tank's hull, or even to the "soothing" rumble of its engine. He's also a hearty eater who will never pass up the chance to inspect a ration pack. Yet despite his appreciation for the more sedentary side of life, this gregarious giant is a formidable fighter who can lift his crew's spirits with a well-timed joke even in the heat of battle. Outside combat, he treasures time with his young daughter, his greatest motivation to return from every mission.

A musician by training, Eugen has a knack for finding order in chaos. For him, any challenge is something to understand and master, not to shy away from, no matter how complex it may appear. That boundless curiosity means he'll never say no to even the most daunting of tasks, but he doesn't leap in all guns blazing; trusting his instinct and cool head under pressure, he listens, analyzes, then moves with the rhythm of the battlefield while others continue to hesitate.
An "old-school" officer. Cold-blooded and prudent, he makes decisions quickly but without rush. He understands the great cost that even the tiniest planning mistake may cause.
A graduate of the Royal Military Academy. He was a military translator who participated in many military actions around the world, picking up experience in operation planning and combat.

A seasoned procurement and logistics officer. He can build the most effective routes while taking frontline military needs into consideration. He believes that well-conducted logistics support is key to winning any battle.
An experienced tank commander and scout. He participates in military discussions, drawing attention to the terrain's specifics and the enemy's locations that are not specified on military maps.
A military engineer who can cross any terrain and break through any fortification. Simply build a pontoon bridge, find a breach in the enemy's defensive lines—and outflank them and strike them down.

Cygan is a dynamic Polish powerhouse who's not just your average content creator and tournament caster—he's also a seasoned World of Tanks virtuoso who'll take your gaming experience to a whole new level as Commander!

The driver of the racing vehicle is awarded for personal achievements during The Great Race event. The Commander has the Brothers in Arms perk trained to 100% and enough experience to train two additional perks to 100%.

Whatever the assignment, Jadwiga Wołoszyn took it on with poise and diligence. As a proud member of the Polish Women's Auxiliary Service, she became part of a remarkable wartime effort that carried her country's spirit far beyond its borders. Her duties shifted with the needs of the day—at times behind the wheel of a transport truck, at others sorting urgent documents or relaying vital communications via radio, and occasionally in basic weapons instruction. Through it all, women like Jadwiga proved indispensable to the cause.

Accomplished boxer Leonard Knox, known to his sparring buddies simply as "Southpaw" for his left-handed stance, has been a military history buff since before he put on his first pair of boxing gloves. And that's saying something, considering he started boxing when he still needed a step stool to reach his gym's water fountain. It's no surprise, then, that this lifelong fan of anything that goes boom, smack, or thwack eventually stepped up as a tank commander. Trading the confines of the ring for sprawling battlefields, Lenny punches well above his weight in every fight.

Primaris Techmarine. Fascinated by machines from a very young age, Vitarian's propensity for all things mechanical did not subside when he was elevated to the ranks of the Astartes. He has a specialist's touch and is often able to coax machinery into performing above its standard ability. He is much more at ease communing with machine spirits rather than with his combat fellows. He keeps the company of machinery, ever trying to perfect the holy relationship between man and machine.

6th Company Sgt. Goran is the current commander of the Repulsor Executioner tank. He has a special affinity with the tank's machine spirit, and often applies aggressive flanking maneuvers, using his vehicle's armor to surprise the enemy. Thankfully, his exceptional skill and complete fearlessness allow him to perform these kinds of moves without fail.

Boris the Blade, AKA the Bullet Dodger, AKA Boris the Butcher. Sound threatening enough? This cold-blooded arms dealer's monikers should tell you all you need to know about him. Boris's past as an undercover agent remains a mystery, but needless to say it molded him into a cool, collected, and highly competent operator. Try not to be the story behind his next nickname.

He might have a funny name for an Englishman, but Turkish is a serious fella. Boxing promoter, slot shop owner, and all-round smooth operator, he's the voice of reason when things are going a bit pear-shaped. Armed with a knack for negotiation and a typically dry English sense of humor, Turkish is a man with a plan — and a few choice words — for any situation.

"Bullet" and "tooth" are two words that shouldn't go together. But Bullet-Tooth Tony isn't a man who plays by conventional rules. He's a man who gets shot six times and has the bullets made into gold teeth — hence the name. A seasoned bounty hunter with a penchant for extreme violence, he exudes an almost eerie sense of calm under pressure. Tony's methods may not always be subtle, but you best believe they're effective.

Named after a gun — NOT a ballet dancer — Tommy is a wheeler-dealer who's not to be messed with. A connoisseur of caravans and lover of dags, Tommy is always in the right place, but at the wrong time. Or the wrong place, but at the right time. Either way, he's got the minerals to rule the battlefield. At least, that's what he thinks.

Four fingers. Yes, that's four, not five. Known to have a soft spot for gambling, this professional gangster and diamond enthusiast once lost a finger in a debt-related misunderstanding. Not that that's stopped him pulling the trigger since, of course. Suave, savvy, and with an impeccable sense of style, Franky Four Fingers is an expert in all things criminal.

Trained in the mysterious ways of the Bene Gesserit, Lady Jessica's powers of perception are unparalleled, making her a formidable adversary in any battle of wit or strength. Forced by circumstance to reckon with the survival of the Atreides house, Jessica must now harness all her inner resolve as she embarks on a mission that will determine the fate of the Known Universe.

"Small-town sheriff"? Some may sneer, but for Will Teasle, there's no higher honor than being the man who maintains the public order in Hope, Washington—and nothing worse than law-breaking drifters like John Rambo. A fiercely territorial enforcer whose pride can spill over into prejudice, Sheriff Teasle will tolerate no disturbance to his town's sleepy northwestern tranquility. And make no mistake: he'll make sure anyone he deems a threat to his authority as sheriff will feel the full force of the law.

A smooth talker and accomplished negotiator, Marshall Murdock is a true-blue American dedicated to serving his country and its citizens. Or that's what he'd have you believe, at least. Yet behind Murdock's charming demeanor is a calculating, pragmatic mind that's focused on self-preservation. An expert at manipulating situations to his advantage, Murdock is ready to do whatever it takes to protect his own interests—and it's never quite clear where his loyalties lie.

Veteran. Lone wolf. Survivor. Whatever you call him, John James Rambo is a force to be reckoned with. Resilient, resourceful, and extraordinarily powerful, this battle-hardened warrior is the ultimate fighting machine—yet, having seen things no man should, he is tortured by agonizing memories of the horrors of war. While his struggles to return to civilian life may put him at odds with those in authority, Rambo is deeply loyal and wants nothing more than to find peace—both for himself and for those he holds dear.

Friend, mentor, and one-time commanding officer to Rambo, Colonel Samuel Trautman is one of the few people who truly understands the troubled former Green Beret. Where others see a merciless soldier conditioned to kill, Trautman sees a tormented soul haunted by unspeakable trauma and in desperate need of guidance and support. A decorated combat veteran himself, Trautman walks a fine line between loyalty to his country and loyalty to his protégé, fighting Rambo's corner when no one else will.

Armed with exceptional combat skills and a resourceful mind, Co Bao is a determined freedom fighter committed to the struggle for liberation and a brighter future. But her tough exterior hides a pure heart and a genuine care for the fate of those dear to her. Risking everything to help Rambo, she remains resolute in the face of overwhelming adversity. Compassionate and positive to the last, Co Bao firmly believes that no one, especially not Rambo, is expendable.

Santa Claus needs no introduction. What he does need, however, is a break. He’s got a to-do list longer than an elf's overtime sheet and a couple of billion gifts to deliver on a very tight schedule. And now, on top of all that, he’s got a new challenge to contend with: the dastardly scheming of his one-time associate, Charles Krampowski, who has taken it upon himself to ruin Christmas once and for all. Santa, of course, won't stand for it. He might be known for his cheerful demeanor and booming laugh, but he's not going to let anyone spoil the festive season. This year, it's war.

Like his origins, Charles Krampowski's motives are shrouded in mystery. A mechanic of undeniable talent, there was a time when he worked shoulder-to-shoulder with Santa, crafting mechanical marvels for the best-behaved tankers. Over time, however, he began to develop a taste for chaos. Now, banished from Santa's workshop and condemned to the naughty list, he's hell-bent on turning festive fun into holiday havoc. The battle for Christmas is beginning, and it's going to get explosive. Whose side are you on?

Once a dedicated Detroit police officer, Alex Murphy was brutally wounded in the line of duty and resurrected as a cybernetically enhanced law enforcement unit known as RoboCop. Engineered by the mega-corporation Omni Consumer Products, RoboCop is outfitted with advanced targeting systems, bulletproof armor, and the prime directive to serve the public trust, protect the innocent, and uphold the law. Even RoboCop himself isn't sure where the man ends and the machine begins. But man or machine, patrol car or tank—it makes no difference. Dead or alive, you're coming with him.

Overworked, world-weary, and constantly running damage control, Sergeant Warren Reed's commitment to his city is remarkable. A veteran of Detroit's decaying law enforcement infrastructure, Reed has spent decades holding the thin, frayed blue line. After so many years on the force, he thought he'd seen it all. That was before RoboCop came online. Whether this shiny new addition to the roster turns out to be a breakthrough or a liability, time will tell. Whatever happens, Reed's approach won't change. He'll do what he's always done—his job.

Ambitious and sharp-tongued, Bob Morton is a rising star at Omni Consumer Products and the brains behind the RoboCop program. He may not be as overtly villainous as some of his shadier colleagues, but don't let the slick charm fool you—this career-driven opportunist will stop at nothing to climb the corporate ladder. That includes manipulating events behind the scenes and putting Detroit's finest in harm's way to secure the ideal candidate for his cyborg law enforcer. After all, who needs morals when you're swimming in cash? That's how it's done in the big leagues.

All it takes is one wary glance at Emil Antonowsky to know exactly who you're dealing with—and how unlucky you are. This slimy denizen of Old Detroit's sprawling criminal underworld lives for the intoxicating rush that only chaos and destruction can bring, and his next hit can never come soon enough. For someone whose hobbies include robbing gas stations and terrorizing cops, Emil somehow manages to carry himself with the swagger of a rock star... if that rock star lived in a sewer and brushed his teeth with motor oil.

Anne Lewis is a seasoned field officer with the Detroit Police Department. As Alex Murphy's partner, she was among the first to see the humanity still alive beneath RoboCop's armored exterior. Tough and level-headed, yet grounded by a strong moral compass, Lewis stands firm in a city overrun by violence and corruption. Her loyalty to the badge and relentless drive to do what's right make her a hero in a place that desperately needs one. She's a cop who still believes in serving the public trust, even when the odds are stacked against her.

Violent thug Leon Nash wouldn't know right from wrong if it spit him in the face. Or maybe he just doesn't give a damn. Either way, this trigger-happy member of crime boss Clarence Boddicker's notorious gang is the last guy you'd want to run into on the mean streets of Old Detroit. He's more used to joyriding stolen sports cars than driving tanks, but commanding a bulletproof monster truck on treads—with a massive gun on top, no less—sounds like this loose cannon's idea of a seriously good time.

Eighteen years of infantry service did not change this soldier's demeanor at all. He is still a fun and light-hearted hulk of a man who loves to place bets, believes in his luck, and always relies on chance. He got into the desert by flipping a coin—what else is there to say? His carelessness got him into mortal danger several times, but he always got away unscathed. His catchphrase is "Betcha I'll come back alive."

A military translator who can quickly adapt to any specifics of any military branch. A polyglot who knows eight languages, including Swahili. After the passing of his comrade in arms, Leo Sommer, he keeps to himself, which is why he prefers to work alone and prefers not to make new friends. While working in the archives, he found a mention of an ancient scroll that was considered lost, and not a week later, he was a part of a special desert expedition.

Only three people have access to this spy's personal file. According to some info, she is the daughter of an intel officer and an actress. She was recruited at a young age and is considered the best in covert operations. In addition to her remarkable wits, she also makes active use of her good looks. She was sent to the desert by the order of higher commanding officers, but she never wanted to go there.

A son of an Australian Army officer who rarely received praise from his father, which made him a perfectionist in everything since childhood. He is an outgoing person, considered to be a go-to guy by his friends, even though he can be annoyingly diligent, always following army regulations to the letter. He is a bit narcissistic, but he will never admit it to anyone—not even himself.

Colette grew up in the countryside and knows first-hand what hard work is—and also how to throw a party. She never tried to be feminine or delicate, and if she ever goes anywhere with a handbag, it is only to conceal her Ruby pistol. She defies established rules and always speaks her mind, which is why she is still a lieutenant. However, as long as she remains in command of her crew, she does not seem to care.

He does not look like a hard-boiled commander. He does not need glory, recognition, or awards. Even so, Adaškevič always performs his missions with the utmost responsibility. He is not used to sharing his plans, especially considering they are coming to life exactly the opposite: A true patriot of his country, he is forced to serve away from his fatherland, and his only friend recently went missing on a mission that was supposed to last eight hours. In moments of desperation, Stefan unknowingly hums his favorite song about red poppies, even though his voice is not like it used to be anymore.

A brilliant student and a very creative person. She never misses an opportunity to do things by herself, knowing full well that her initiative will not go unpunished. She taught herself several languages (including Italian) and finished a special crypto radio operators class with flying colors. She is married, but she does not like to discuss her personal life.

A German tankman. He is equally at home as a combat vehicle commander and an inquisitive scientist. Since high school, he has been drawn to the natural sciences and has an excellent understanding of chemistry, biology, and physics. He constantly keeps a journal in which he records everything in the form of indecipherable notes and rather visual illustrations.

A courageous, independent warrior from the Fremen, who inhabit Arrakis. Raised in the age-old traditions of her people, she is unconditionally devoted to her fellow Fremen and defending her home planet, Dune. She is at home in the harsh conditions of the desert planet and is prepared to give everything for the freedom and prosperity of her people.
Battle Pass Season XII, Chapter "Distant Futures"

This young scout's deceptive appearance has proven fatal for many. She is a natural at collecting data on the enemy. Her specialty is radar reconnaissance, where she employs a systematic approach and analytical thinking to the maximum for decision-making. She is capable of taking risks to save her comrades.

This American's formidable appearance hides a sharp mind and a subtle sense of humor. He is not afraid of anything and anybody, or at least so he thinks. For a long time, he fought under the command of McReed, with whom he initially struggled to find common ground due to his own sharp wit. Throughout his career, he successfully completed dozens of combat missions and developed a sense of discipline before becoming a competent commander. That said, he has not stopped making jokes, whether they land well or not.

A leading researcher at the Research Institute (crossed out). Supervisor of the first and subsequent groups sent to Mirny-13. She approaches her work very meticulously, sometimes even obsessively. She does not accept compromises. If she sets a goal, she will stop at nothing to achieve it.

A courageous, independent warrior from the Fremen, who inhabit Arrakis. Raised in the age-old traditions of her people, she is unconditionally devoted to her fellow Fremen and defending her home planet, Dune. She is at home in the harsh conditions of the desert planet and is prepared to give everything for the freedom and prosperity of her people.
Battle Pass Season XII, Chapter "Distant Futures"

A fearless warrior and wise bard whose songs inspire courage in those around him. Having survived the onslaughts of the Harkonnens and Sardaukar warriors, his loyalty to House Atreides is as unwavering as his determination to exact revenge on his mortal enemies. He is adept at finding ways out of seemingly hopeless situations and was able to find common ground with the inhabitants of Arrakis, so armored warfare should not pose him too many problems.

The tyrannical Harkonnen governor of Arrakis is the epitome of power and ruthlessness. He is a fierce warrior and an authoritative commander for whom the end always justifies the means. He demands supreme military discipline from his subordinates and will crush anyone who dares stand in his way.
A Harkonnen soldier known for his cruelty and lack of tolerance for dissent. Boasting a keen intellect and razor-sharp military cunning, he has mastered the art of close combat.
Battle Pass Season XII, Chapter "Distant Futures"

A skillful and incredibly resilient Imperial Army soldier. He recognizes no authority but that of the Emperor, whose will he executes without hesitation. Years of intense military training have led him to see himself as superior to others. He demonstrates his tactical genius and composure in battle by always choosing the right moment to strike.
Battle Pass Season XII, Chapter "Distant Futures"

A fearless warrior who always stands for what's right, Leonardo is the natural leader of the Turtle gang. When his brothers look to him for inspiration and guidance, Leo is always there for them—whether they appreciate it or not. Armed with an unwavering sense of justice and the courage to act upon it, Leo and his katana are always ready to fight to the very end, because, as he says, "We Turtles don't know the meaning of the word 'defeat!'"

With a brilliant mind and boundless scientific curiosity, Donatello is the brains of the Turtle gang—and he's one Turtle you want by your side when you need a way out of a sticky situation. A true tech wiz, some of his ideas might be a little too zany—and he has a habit of speaking in technobabble—but his quick thinking and innovative inventions have saved the Turtles' shells on more than one occasion.

Cool but rude? Yeah, that's right, and what's it to you? Strong, short-tempered, and with a tongue as sharp as the sai he wields, Raphael is not a Turtle you want to upset. He might come across as a world-weary cynic...okay, he IS a world-weary cynic, but that's only because he cares so deeply about protecting his brothers. Just don't get on his nerves—the only thing that hurts more than Raphael's sai attacks are his sarcastic put-downs.

Fighting crime and standing against evil? Eh. Video games, skateboarding, and a big slice of a pepperoni pizza? Now we're talking! Sure, Mikey's priorities might be a little...different, but he's no slouch. Powered by pizza and with a smile on his face, Mikey is a party dude who lifts his brothers' spirits at the toughest of times—and he's always ready to dish out some serious nunchuck justice. Cowabunga!

Formerly a ninjutsu student named Oroku Saki, the Shredder assumed his new identity after a bitter feud with a fellow student—one Hamato Yoshi. Now leader of the Foot Clan, the Shredder is consumed by an obsessive desire for vengeance against his old rival—now known as Master Splinter—and his Turtle sons. Clad in razor-sharp armor and with loyal enforcers ready to do his evil bidding, he will stop at nothing until he gets his wish: to dine on turtle soup!

Krang may not have a body, but he does have an ambition: to take over the world! Banished to Earth from his home of Dimension X in mysterious circumstances, Krang is hell-bent on world domination, and has joined forces with the evil Shredder to achieve his goal. With some seriously impressive technology at his disposal—including a powerful android body and a mobile battle fortress, the Technodrome—he's not going to let a few measly Turtles stand in his way!

Whaddya mean Bebop ain't the sharpest tool in the shed? The only sharp tools he needs are ones for taking apart Toitles! What he may lack in self-awareness, he makes up for in strength, and Bebop is a real tough guy who's great at following orders. That means he's ready to do whatever the Shredder and his partner-in-crime Rocksteady tell him to—and if that involves teaching some puny little Toitles a lesson, even better!

Hey, Rocksteady's the brains of the operation here! Never seen without his loyal accomplice Bebop, Rocksteady is one mean rhinoceros ready to go to any lengths to do the Shredder's dirty work and teach them Turtles a lesson. Sure, his "genius" plans might not always work out, but he's a hard-headed hoodlum who won't stop until they do. When Rocksteady's around, no Turtles are safe from being splatterized!

Live for Channel 6 News, New York City's most determined reporter has a knack for being where the action is. With a big heart and an even bigger dedication to getting the greatest scoops, April is a true professional and an invaluable ally to her newfound friends. She's not quite sure how she ended up patrolling the city sewers with a team of crime-fighting Turtles, but one thing is certain—it's going to be the story of the year!

A Manchester lad who was raised to value duty, honor, and discipline above all else, Arthur always seemed destined to lead. Now that he serves King and country, his secret weapons are a healthy dose of northern grit to help him through adversity and an English wit dry enough to defuse even the tensest of situations. A natural diplomat and diligent strategist, Arthur is the glue that holds his crew together, maintaining a steely resolve and unwavering focus on the task at hand even when emotions run high.

Much to the exasperation of his superiors, Jack hates playing by the rules, preferring to trust his gut and do what feels right instead. Thankfully for all concerned, he's blessed with remarkable intuition and an uncanny ability to improvise his way out of danger. Competitive, courageous, and competent beyond his years, Jack is the all-American ace in his crew's pack, with an unpredictable streak that keeps enemies guessing and an unshakeable confidence that he'll always come up trumps.

Passionate, patriotic, and dedicated to his Patrie, Louis' love for his country compelled him to join France's Resistance immediately after the occupation began. But while he always stands for what's right, Louis is not just a hot-headed idealist: as rugged as the cliffs of his native Normandy, he's also a fearless fighter and shrewd tactician with a knack for always seeing the bigger picture. Tireless in his determination, he will stop at nothing until his beloved France knows freedom once more.

As devastation began to ravage Poland, Roman knew the time had come to follow in the footsteps of those who had fought through the centuries for his country's freedom. A logical thinker with a plan for all eventualities, he demonstrates exceptional composure even under intense enemy fire. With a kind heart and a classic sense of Polish hospitality, Roman lifts his crewmates' spirits when times are hard—but it's the thought of returning to his homeland once the war finally ends that keeps him going.

Drawn by the allure of the black beret, Richard served in the Royal Tank Regiment for nearly 30 years. Having started as a Chieftain driver—where he did more repairing than driving—his journey through the ranks saw him master diverse roles and command various vehicles, including the Challenger 1 and 2 and the Scorpion. On top of stints as a Gunnery Instructor and teaching Armored Tactics, Richard also worked with various countries' armed forces during deployments across the globe.

David Baggley, aka “eekeeboo”, aka “eek”, is infamous for his quirky tactics and talent for flipping tanks. He occasionally serenades allies with lullabies, boosting his team's morale and leaving enemies fuming. His trademark phrase, "Boop of nope", is rumored to be the last thing foes hear before their destruction.

When he was young, Tommy would always be tinkering with something, taking apart family radios and other gadgets just to see what was inside—often to the dismay of his parents. His penchant for experimentation proved more than just child's play, eventually attracting the attention of the Alliance, who tasked him with developing advanced tank shield systems. There, Tommy's scientific flair, combined with his meticulous planning and surgical precision, won him the respect of a certain colleague by the name of Max von Krieger.

Marion was raised with the firm belief that the collective is more important than the individual—and she always wanted to be part of something with truly global significance. When the Alliance came calling and she encountered the boundless ambition of Max von Krieger, she knew she was in the right place. While extremely methodical and rational in her work on EMP technology—which she understands could have far-reaching, even devastating consequences—Marion is always willing to put aside personal concerns to serve the greater good.

Andrey is a man of few words and advocate of decisive action over idle chit-chat. If he has received an order from above, he won't rest until it's carried out—and to the very highest standard at that. His relentless focus on the task at hand can be jarring to those who don't know him, but Andrey isn't interested in proving anything to anyone. He's a model professional whose unparalleled railgun expertise has proven invaluable to the Alliance.

If there's one thing Xing believes in, it's the power of science to change the world for the better. Guided by a strong sense of discipline and a resolute belief that what she is doing is right, she is an energy systems expert of the highest order, always seeking ways to harness the technology she believes can be a force for good. Having left her home to contribute to the mission of the Alliance, her diligent approach and innovative thinking have greatly advanced the organisation's research capabilities.

The legendary Viking king Ragnar Lothbrok is a man of many dreams and many failings. Curious and intelligent yet extremely dangerous, he is driven by an insatiable thirst for conquest and glory. Ragnar has led many daring raids on England and Francia, but not simply for plunder—he seeks to carve his name into legend. And, if the gods will it, he will succeed.

The gods deprived this man of the ability to walk, giving his enemies at least a small chance against him. But Ivar the Boneless, son of Ragnar and Aslaug, is violent and ruthless even by Viking standards. In a world where strength defines men, being crippled is no easy burden, yet Ivar managed to become a ferocious warrior and a master tactician. Although Ragnar recognizes Ivar's unyielding anger as a gift, at times it may cloud his judgment.

Ragnar's oldest son, Bjorn has rarely shown any true interest in being a ruler. Rather, he is an adventurer, just like his father. It is Ragnar's qualities, such as vision and wanderlust, that incite Bjorn to forge his own way in the world. He always strives to do what’s best for his people and, though not always successful, he is a great leader treated with respect. And a great warrior, too—after all, they call him Ironside for a reason.

Lagertha is a proud and earnest shield-maiden who became the first wife of Ragnar Lothbrok—not that she let him dictate her fate, of course. In a time when strength is the key to survival, Lagertha is ready to do whatever it takes to protect her loved ones. With a good number of battles to her name, she can easily discern who is a skilled fighter and who is not. And most men...a single glance is enough for Lagertha to know they are no match for her.

An odd hermit, a dangerous trickster, a genius craftsman with a talent for building ships and towers—Floki is too complex a person to be captured in a single phrase. Just like his closest friend Ragnar, he is always searching and exploring the world around him and, true to the Viking ways, he lives to please the gods and help his fellow men. With his infectious giggle, Floki may look innocuous to a stranger, but that nonchalant facade hides a ferocious killer.

A seasoned commander who never leaves a job half-done, Tomasz has two passions: armored vehicles, and, paradoxical though it may seem, the natural world. When not busy motivating his crew to outshine the competition, he can be found with a notebook in hand, documenting the rare flora and fauna of his surroundings. Good-natured, confident, and endlessly inquisitive, Tomasz's boundless curiosity led him to seize the opportunity to take his tanking expertise to the jungles of central Africa, where he balances his love for machinery and nature to impressive effect.

With his air of quiet confidence and iron discipline, Wataru doesn't give the impression of a man who likes to create chaos just for fun. Yet, as a keen motorcycle racer in his youth, he developed a deep love for machines and a mean competitive streak—as well as a defiant disregard for rules and regulations. Though his wild days racing through the neon-lit streets of Tokyo are behind him, his passion for high-octane competition endures—but what drives Wataru most of all is the pursuit of becoming better than the man he once was.

Hailing from a secluded village in the lush mountain forests of southwest Germany, Konrad dreamed of writing a great novel about his native land—because surely there couldn't be anywhere more perfect than his beloved Schwarzwald? Fate, however, had other plans; a rugged, and resourceful military man, he was selected for a key role in groundbreaking tank trials halfway across the world. While he misses the crisp mountain air of his home, the demands of his new surroundings have awakened fresh stories within him—and inspired him to write even more.

A gifted linguist, polyglot, and expert negotiator, Angélique always lands on her feet—no matter the mission or the company she keeps. Armed with the ability to effortlessly adapt to new teams, environments, and challenges, she is a resourceful problem-solver who thrives under pressure. While rumors of her past involvement in covert espionage operations only add to her mystique, Angélique neither confirms nor denies such claims, deflecting awkward questions with her charm, intellect, and relentless focus on the task at hand.

Founding partner of Shelby Company Limited, patriarch of the Shelby family, and mastermind behind the Peaky Blinders' criminal empire, Thomas Michael Shelby is, in his own words, an extreme example of what a working man can achieve. Scarred by his experiences in the trenches of northern France, Tommy can sometimes seem detached and desensitized to violence—but he's determined to secure his family's future. Calculating, ambitious, and utterly ruthless when necessary, he's a master strategist who's always one step ahead of those who seek to challenge him—from Small Heath to London and beyond.

A tortured soul with good in his heart but hands that belong to the devil, Arthur is the man who carries out the Peaky Blinders' dirty work—but he's more than just a brutal enforcer. The eldest of the Shelby brothers, Arthur is driven by an unshakable loyalty to his family and a fierce desire to protect his siblings—yet, after the horrors of the Great War, he finds himself battling inner demons as well as the pressures of gang life. Volatile but vulnerable, Arthur seeks solace, understanding, and, ultimately, redemption.

Like his older brothers, John bears the scars of being sent to fight in foreign lands as a young man—and shares the other Shelbys' sense of loyalty, bravery, and honor. Forced to grow up quicker than the rest, his past weighs heavily on him—especially as he has a family of his own to provide for. While he can be quick to act on impulse, John's heart is in the right place—and his determination to protect those he loves means he's never one to shy away from a fight.

The only sister among the Shelby siblings, Ada initially seeks a life of glitz and glamour far removed from the gritty realities of Small Heath and the Peaky Blinders—but her deep affinity for her family soon sees her drawn into Shelby business. Fearless and uncompromising as she navigates a male-dominated world, Ada has little patience for masculine aggression or her unpredictable brothers' bickering. Armed with a sharp intellect and a biting wit, she is a force to be reckoned with both inside and outside the family.

A Shelby in all but name, Michael always harbored ambitions far bigger than the sleepy village he grew up in. Diligent and thoughtful, he is fascinated by the Peaky Blinders and the intrigues of Birmingham's criminal underworld—and eager to play his part in his cousins' ever-growing enterprise. After the dull monotony of life in the country, Michael knows he belongs in the city, even if it means getting his hands dirty. But how far is he willing to go for his family?

A military man from a military family, Matthew Kennedy doesn’t play games—not in the line of duty, at least. Assertive and ultra-competitive, he's a demanding commander who expects nothing less than excellence from himself and his crew—and if something's off, you’ll hear about it. Yet while he's relentless on the battlefield, off it he's surprisingly charismatic. A Boston boy who takes pride in his Irish roots, he forged an especially strong bond with Angus over their Celtic connection, but Matthew commands the respect—and fear—of all who serve with him.

A brilliant anthropologist and one of Lara's few intellectual equals, Amanda Evert was one of her closest friends during their university days—until a mysterious, tragic event in Peru changed everything. Now, shaped by resentment and a lingering sense of betrayal, Amanda has become both a rival and an uneasy counterpart to Lara. Her fascination with the mystical, the unexplained, and ancient secrets has grown into an obsession—one that often puts her at odds with Lara. Though their paths frequently clash, they remain bonded by their shared past—and their relentless search for truth.

Seven years chopping wood non-stop would have broken most men. But Harry Bunyan was not most men. He liked the routine, and the solitude, and the smell of the pines—and, rain or shine, he could always be found in the quiet corner of the forest clearing he'd made his own. Setting his next target in place and dusting off his hands, he would grip the worn handle of his ax and, with an almighty thwack, split the timber clean in two. All day, every day, for seven years. Where all the logs went, not even Harry knew—there was no way the camp needed that much firewood—but he didn't mind. He just kept chopping.

A field kitchen is no place for a chef, they said. Especially not for a proud Parisian, trained in the haute cuisine traditions of the French capital. But that mattered little to Joël—in fact, it only fueled his appetite for adventure. Stubborn, resourceful, and endlessly inventive, he approached the challenge of working with what little he had to hand with relish and customary verve. Sitting by the fire, he would admire his signature pot-au-feu as it bubbled to a boil, infused with the fresh air of the forest glade—and just the faintest hint of steel.

To call Edmund Hart a stickler for the details would have been like calling water wet, or the Maus heavy. He seemed to always be hunched over a table, poring over maps and blueprints, and telling anyone who'd listen about pincer movements and choke points. His obsession with precision wasn't just limited to sketches and schemes, though: he was also a no-nonsense commander who made damn sure the plan was followed to the letter on the battlefield. And if Plan A failed, you could bet your last bonds he had a Plan B, C, and D up his sleeve.

While Oskar's primary task as camp photographer was strictly technical—document operations and equipment, and try not to get in anyone's way—he saw it as much more. For him, it was about capturing the small details, memories, and moments that would otherwise be forgotten. Unseen by his campmates, he would rise before dawn to be in place for the "Goldene Stunde"—the golden hour, when the morning sun would bathe the forest clearing in gentle amber light. To some, it would have been mundane: the same old trees, the same old routines. But Oskar always managed to find the beauty in the everyday.

Busted track? Optics on the blink? Turret not turning? Give Tokarev ten minutes and his battered old toolbox, and it'd be good as new. No job was too small for him, and he had no problem getting his hands dirty—come to think of it, nobody ever saw them clean. Sergei had seen it all and fixed it twice, and built up an encyclopedic knowledge of military hardware in the process. No matter what had broken down, blown up, or fallen off, one thing was always for sure—Sergei would get it moving again.

Angus William Buchanan—better known as "Cannon" for short—may just be Scotland’s finest marksman. No surprise there; years of hunting across the wild moors of the Scottish Highlands where he grew up would sharpen anyone’s eye. Such is his shooting prowess that he occasionally toys with leaving tanking behind to apply for the Special Air Service—but, for now, he's quite happy commanding the twin-barrel beast assigned to him. While his hair may be a fiery red, his temperament is anything but. Cool-headed and precise, Angus never rushes a shot—and rarely misses the mark.

Impossible? Not for Wei Jian. Having endured rigorous training, pushed through grueling challenges, and seen off fierce competition to become one of China's foremost tank engineers, he's not afraid of anything. Where most would see obstacles, Wei Jian sees opportunity—and will happily spend hours poring over blueprints and fine-tuning the smallest of components in search of innovation and maximum performance. His expertise isn’t limited to the drawing board, though; on the battlefield, as in the design bureau, his eye for detail and drive for perfection remain uncompromising.

Becoming a tanker never seemed an obvious path for Alessia. It wasn't that she intentionally defied authority—just, as something of a free spirit, she never really recognized it in the first place. But she craved adventure, and the military certainly offered that. A masterful communicator, she believes in the power of negotiation to resolve any dispute. She knows she can win over anyone if she puts her mind to it—but, if her opponents decline her polite offers of dialogue, then she's happy to let her gun do the talking.

Now you see him, now you're dead. Duke is here, and damn, is he looking good! He needs no introduction, but just in case you’ve been living under a rock—meet the world’s greatest action hero, live and uncensored. He’s faced the meanest foes, conquered the deadliest threats, and always emerged victorious. Now he’s back—to kick ass, dominate the battlefield, and save Earth once again. When Duke's around, a few things are guaranteed: big guns, bigger explosions, and all-out destruction. Hail to the king, baby!

An evil cyborg with an army of loyal Techbots to do his bidding, Dr. Proton is Duke's arch-nemesis—and mankind's greatest threat. Once a brilliant robotics researcher, excessive radiation exposure shattered his mind and twisted his genius into madness. Now, consumed by a thirst for total domination, the Dr. is hell-bent on reshaping the world in his image. Deep in his underground lair, he plots his ultimate victory—and only Duke stands between him and the annihilation of humanity.

Duke may go where he pleases—and please where he goes—but if there's one person he knows he can count on when things get hot, it's General Graves. A seasoned professional with a hardened, no-nonsense demeanor, the General has a plan for every alien invasion. With years of fighting existential threats in the Earth Defense Force under his belt, he's armed with unmatched tactical acumen—and the intel Duke needs to get the job done. Together, they make sure the bad guys never stand a chance.

Tomb Raider, relic hunter, and adventure icon, Lara Croft is an intrepid explorer who believes that the extraordinary lies in what we do, not who we are. Heiress to the Croft legacy, she found herself drawn to the allure of the unknown, opting for a life of adventure far beyond the confines of her high-society upbringing. While Lara carries herself with grace and poise, mistake her good manners and charisma for weakness at your peril. Fearless and tenacious, she's no stranger to a hard-fought battle—and can disarm foes just as easily with her razor-sharp wit as with her combat skills.

A sailor and cook with a big appetite and an even bigger heart, Jonah Maiava is Lara's closest friend and most trusted confidant. His thoughtful, introspective nature helps keep Lara grounded when her drive pushes her to the edge—while his protection instincts and calm demeanor make him a steadfast companion on even the most perilous expeditions. A true gentle giant with a kind soul, Jonah knows Lara better than anyone else and remains utterly dedicated to his best friend—no matter what the stakes.

Few know where Anton Mekhanin was born—he probably crawled out of a steel hatch wearing a welding mask. A tireless perfectionist, he's turned the art of tank testing into a personal crusade. Known for pushing vehicles to the limit (and beyond), it'll take more than an explosion to make him sweat. Rumor has it that he once rebuilt a busted T-34 using just scrap metal and an Allen wrench. His obsession borders on the unhinged, but no one can argue with his results. Besides, with a name like Mekhanin, how could he have turned out any other way?

Once a small-town sheriff's deputy, Rick Grimes woke from a coma to find the world overrun by the dead—and the living soon proved no less dangerous. Despite the ruthlessness of this new reality, Rick holds on to his principles as best he can. Guided by a deep sense of duty to protect those he loves, he has evolved from lawman to hardened survivor. A natural leader, he's earned the trust of those who follow him. Morality weighs heavily on him, yet Rick never hesitates to do what's necessary.

Negan is a former high school gym teacher. As brutal as he is charismatic, he's a tyrant to his enemies and a savior to his people. Don't let Negan’s bravado fool you, though—this is a man shaped by loss. His weapon of choice, a baseball bat wrapped in barbed wire, is named Lucille in honor of his late wife. Negan built his following on fear and control, but whether he can rebuild himself into a better human being is another matter entirely.

Rugged survivalist Daryl Dixon grew up on the edges of society, learning early in life what it takes to thrive in harsh circumstances. Lethal with a crossbow and possessing a keen instinct for tracking, his expertise makes him a valuable asset to his group. Though a man of few words, Daryl's loyalty runs deep once you've earned his respect. This is a man who will go to any lengths to protect his newfound family.

Before society fell apart, Michonne was a lawyer. In this lawless new world, her keen situational awareness and pragmatism have proved indispensable to her survival. Michonne once kept two walker pets on leashes to move unnoticed among the hordes of dead—a grim but effective form of camouflage. Always wielding her signature katana, this hardened warrior refuses to let the brutality of the apocalypse cloud her judgment. In her own words: "Anger makes you stupid. Stupid gets you killed."
