Philip Blake, more commonly known as The Governor, maintains strict control over the fortified town of Woodbury. He positions himself as a beacon of safety, promising to shield his community from the chaos beyond the gates. Yet he operates through authoritarian means, his sociopathic tendencies and capacity for violence masked by his outward charm—making him all the more dangerous.

Hugo "Axle" Kern is a seasoned tank tester, his iron resolve tempered in the fire of countless trials. His battered wrench never leaves his side—not just for repairs, but to feel the pulse of a machine. He taps the hull, listening intently for the subtle hum that says "go." Any tank that doesn't pass his test is torn apart and rebuilt, no exceptions. With decades of experience and nerves of carbon steel, Hugo forces the future of tank design with each test. Under Kern's stern command, only the strongest, fastest, and most deadly tanks survive.

Lucien Acier is a battlefield tinkerer with a brilliant mind and zero chill. Armed with his trusty wrench and a metric ton of wild ideas, he's all about reworking existing vehicles into logic-defying, mind-bending monsters. Engines run hotter, turrets spin faster, and enemy tanks burn brighter—even if nobody's quite sure how (not even Lucien himself). After all, this mad scientist isn't here to follow blueprints. He's here to break the rules and build something revolutionary. If it smokes, sparks, or shakes the ground, odds are Lucien had something to do with it.

Cassie Riggs grew up turning rust buckets into hot rods on her dad's junkyard, and now she does the exact same thing with tanks. Breezing through upgrade sessions and field tests with a signature smirk on her face, Cassie remolds machines like she's daring them to keep up. Crank up the power here, reroute some wiring there—BOOM, you've got a fire-breathing behemoth that's "technically within regulations." She's used to being the only woman on the test field, but that's never fazed her. Cassie knows she's the one they'll call when their arsenal needs to stop surviving and start dominating.

I've been shot and scarred more times than I care to count. They've thrown war machines, genetically-engineered freaks... heck, even entire battalions at me. The USA surrendered, and I kept on fightin’ anyhow. I've seen the world burn and come crawlin' outta the fire. Yeah, I've seen the worst those monsters have to offer—and I've sent it all straight to hell. It ain't that hard: inhale, count to four—exhale, count to four, and I get the job done. So, you with me? 'Cause if we stop, they win. And I don't plan on giving them that satisfaction, not today.

Ah... look at you. So serious, so scared. Delicious.

Weakness is a disease, and I am its cure. I have seen what the world becomes without order: filth, noise, chaos... resistance. But I corrected that. Pain is my instrument, and oh... how beautifully I play. Each scream, a note in my divine symphony. When they beg? When they break? Ach, how it moves me. I demand perfection... and I punish everything else. Do not question me. Do not fail me. Or I will compose your screams into my next masterpiece.

So, mein Schatz, serve with grace... or decorate the floor.

They call me a monster. A madman. I call myself an engineer of human limitations.
I do not waste time on sentiment—I eliminate variables. While the masses cling to their obsolete ethics, I operate beyond the constraints of feeble morality. The human body, in its current state, is a crude, inefficient vessel that cripples our true potential. My work corrects that. I pursue total anatomical supremacy. Lesser minds do not comprehend my methods, but all shall witness the results.
Now, unless your presence contributes to measurable outcomes, begone. Efficiency is everything.

They keep finding people to fight. And we keep fighting. There was a time I thought words alone could change the world—books, ideas, truth. I was a student, once. A dreamer. I thought knowledge would be enough, and then I watched as they burned my home in the name of their twisted vision. I do not dream anymore. Now, I work—with words, with weapons, with whatever I must. I've broadcast from deep underground while bombs fell overhead. I've carried messages, weapons, and fallen allies through smoke-choked tunnels. I've learned to shoot, to lead, to bleed if I must—but always, always to resist.

They broke my body in Deathshead's compound—thought that would stop me. It'll take more than that to keep me down. I've led charges from the shadows, dismantled their machines, and kept the Resistance burning long after the world gave up. Da'at Yichud suit or not, I stand. Rebels, radicals, traitors... Let them call us whatever they want, but we're on the right side of history. So if you're here to whine, leave. If you're here to fight, get moving. Targets are marked, tracks are hot. Gear up, soldier, and let's get to work.

When Daniel Zima—a watchmaker by trade—unexpectedly inherited his uncle's radio workshop, he thought the constant hum of tools and crackle of transmissions would drive him mad. But before long, he became captivated by the invisible world of radio waves, spending hours tuning in to signals from far-off places and imagining the lives behind them, worlds far removed from his sleepy Moravian town. Now, in the frozen north, Daniel uses his affinity for mechanisms of all kinds to decode the unseen threads of the wider world, tracking transmissions few others will ever hear.

The daily rigors and shortages of his early life taught Otto Faber that order is the antidote to chaos. He soon found his calling as a reconnaissance specialist, honing an uncanny ability to track signals and decode transmissions with a relentless exactitude that would put even the most meticulous professor to shame. Under Faber's exacting eye, every reading was perfectly precise, every signal catalogued without fail. Yet, despite all his training, the frozen north threw anomalies that confounded even Otto's methodical mind.

Jack Hawke was the son of a coal miner, raised in the shadow of the Appalachians. Gifted with a knack for understanding how things ticked, he enlisted in the Army to make sure he didn't end up working underground. He started in the motor pool and worked his way into the armored corps, earning his stripes on the Alaskan frontier before heading across the Atlantic. Ironically, the boy who had enlisted to avoid life underground now found himself navigating a different kind of hidden world, mapping the frozen expanse on a covert scouting mission.

Elin Bergfalk grew up immersed in amateur radio, spending long winters chasing faint signals across Europe and decoding messages. Her affinity for the invisible currents of the air soon caught the attention of a classified electronic warfare program. There, she quickly earned a reputation for detecting anomalies and interference patterns that baffled even senior officers. Now a seasoned systems engineer and signals intelligence specialist, she has been called back to the frozen landscapes of her youth—this time operating from the camouflaged confines of a tank.

Don't get it mixed up: Paulie Lombardo might enjoy cracking wise every now and then, but he's no stranger to cracking a few heads when the job demands it either. A seasoned mobster with a positive attitude who takes an immediate liking to Tommy, Paulie tries to keep the mood light, even when the situation is anything but. Life in the family, though, weighs him down more than he'd like to admit. Normally amiable and easygoing, he grapples with a deep-rooted malaise and bouts of explosive anger that can have devastating consequences.

Everything Tommy Angelo's ever done, both good and bad, he's done for his family. But he never thought he'd have to do things like this. He was just trying to get by, making ends meet as a cabbie on the streets of Lost Heaven, until a chance encounter—and quick getaway—with Don Salieri's boys turned his life upside down. Now, entangled deeper in a life of crime and racketeering than he could ever have expected, Tommy is a made man who's earned the respect of those around him the hard way. But, whatever happens, family still comes first. Always.

Salieri's best friend since their childhood in Sicily, Frank Colletti is the faithful consigliere who knows the Don better than anyone. An experienced mediator and prudent advisor, he acts as the respectable face of the family's often less-than-respectable enterprises. He knows bloodshed is bad for business, so warns against it where possible: partly to preserve clients' trust, but also because he genuinely cares about Tommy, Paulie, and Sam. His intimate knowledge of the family's inner workings, however, means he's a prime target for those with a score to settle with the Don.

Sam Trapani is the type of enforcer any Don would kill for: street-smart, disciplined, and fiercely loyal to the family code of honor. Having carried out Salieri's orders throughout Little Italy and beyond, he's learned to shoot first and think...actually, he's learned it's best not to think at all. More taciturn and to-the-point than his loudmouth accomplice Paulie, Sam prefers to get things done with maximum efficiency and minimal talk. He's also guided by a strong sense of justice—and won't hesitate in turning the gun on anyone he deems to have wronged him.

There are two things Don Ennio Salieri can't stand: foul language and rats. The charismatic head of one of the two families vying for control over Lost Heaven's rackets, Salieri has built up a reputation as a respectable father figure among the people of Little Italy his boys protect. But while he may well care about those under his watch, he cares more about his business—and, when push comes to shove, that pillar of the community facade gives way to the ruthless mob boss beneath. So if Don Salieri makes you an offer, you best damn well think twice before you refuse it.

A veteran of Polish units in North Africa, Eryk Wojciechowski is no stranger to the dunes. Even when visibility vanishes in a cloud of sand or hostile units swarm the convoy like locusts, he remains unnervingly calm. As unflappable as he is mysterious, he is never seen without his damaged wristwatch, its hands stuck in place. Eryk has yet to explain why he refuses to repair it, though he can pinpoint the time of day to the minute with a mere glance across the dunes. He once called Krakow home, but it seems the desert has claimed him since.

Years in Algerian reconnaissance taught Lieutenant Pierre Leclerc to read the land as if it were one of the treasured volumes in his personal library. A natural raconteur, he entertains the crew with colorful anecdotes, often lacing his speech with words borrowed from French, Arabic, and local dialects—even in the heat of action. Cunning and observant, he prides himself on noticing what others overlook, stroking his thick beard before delivering a detailed report of events yet to unfold. The desert is friend to no man, but Leclerc comes closer than most.

Captain Li Wei Zhang built his career in remote desert regions where the heat could cripple both engines and men. Enduring such conditions taught him to rely on discipline and preparation above all else. His words are few and direct, but not without warmth—unless he is made to repeat himself or finds a hatch left unsealed against the elements. Zhang expects total competence in every task, but each sunset, regardless of the day's trials, he brews tea in his trusty flask and shares it with his crew. Among the shifting sands, this ritual is a welcome constant.

Dr. Elizabeth Harrington grew up hearing tales of Egyptian expeditions from her officer father, but she laid her own path from the fog and drizzle of London to the deserts and dust of North Africa. An expert geologist and master analyst, she can predict sandstorms hours in advance and maintain her polished poise even in the harshest of conditions. Treating the desert as a matter of diplomacy, she is a firm believer that meticulous notes, careful observation, and respect for the environment will yield the best outcome for all.

Once a respected geneticist, Doctor George Wilhelm Krieger built his career on enhancing soldiers' combat performance. His reputation, however, collapsed when his unsanctioned testing on humans came to light. Forced into exile from the scientific community, he resumed his dealings from the shadows, using his ill-gotten gains to establish a covert research facility on a remote archipelago, guarded by his own private army of mercenaries. There, he seeks to reactivate primal abilities long lost to human evolution—a volatile power that, once unleashed, may be impossible to contain.

Ex-Navy officer Jack Carver puts his lethal set of skills to use as a private boat charter in the South Pacific. When he's hired to take a reporter to a remote island, things quickly get out of hand—his boat is destroyed by a missile fired by mercenaries moments after arrival. Stranded ashore, Jack is contacted by a mysterious insider who reveals the island's disturbing secrets. He soon uncovers a horrific experiment led by the disgraced scientist Dr. Krieger, who plans to replace humanity with engineered super-beings. Now, Jack must stop the operation and find a way back to civilization.

"You are fearless. You will defeat anyone who stands in your way."
Citra Talugmai is the enigmatic leader of the Rakyat tribe, revered as a living goddess. A warrior of striking beauty, her magnetic presence is matched only by her devotion to her beliefs and her relentless ambition to restore her people to greatness. Through a hypnotic blend of allure and manipulation, she ensnares the outsider Jason Brody, drawing him into her sway and stoking the darkness within him to nurture his descent into madness in service of her own twisted vision.

Talented and intelligent but lacking direction, Jason Brody drifts through life, focusing on partying, extreme sports, and his girlfriend, Liza—despite their clashes over his refusal to buckle down. Now stranded on a hostile island, he is finally forced to concentrate on one goal: rescuing his friends. In the process, he uncovers within himself a frightening capacity for violence, a natural instinct for survival, and a growing thirst for vengeance... along with a place where he might truly belong. But everything comes at a cost, and whether he's willing to pay it remains to be determined.

"Our great and glorious leader who has risked his life and limb to bring Kyrat out of the past. He sacrifices everything for his adopted homeland and loves its people like his own children. May Pagan's light shine upon you all."
Self-styled King of Kyrat, Pagan Min rules the tumultuous and remote nation through a brutal dictatorship enforced by his private army. Flamboyant, sadistic, and brazenly narcissistic, he pivots from playful banter to nauseating brutality in an instant—savoring each with the same refined relish as his impeccably plated meals.

Vadim Kuprin knew the barren salt flats of his current mission like the back of his equally weather-beaten hand. No stranger to volatile environments, he had earned his stripes specializing in chemical warfare defense long before he ever boarded a tank. Twenty years later, he found himself a mere few days' trek from the lab compound where he had begun his military service as a junior technician. Time and tribulation leave no man unscathed, but, as Vadim joked to his crew, no paperwork had been filed for his discharge—so until someone submitted it properly, he was here to stay.

The lush valleys of Bryn Powell's boyhood were a world away from the harsh climes that he came to know. His latest briefing was remarkably short on details, and the phrases "unidentified chemical agent" and "risk of mortal danger: extreme" would have many commanders praying for reassignment. But Bryn always regarded self-preservation as an admirable quality in other people. A daredevil by nature, he could have had a glittering career as a stuntman if he'd ever felt the urge. Put him behind the controls of a tank, and the difference was negligible.

Nagai Sora was an unflappable commander. A veteran of peacekeeping missions in unstable regions, he had learned how to hold his nerve as pressure closed in. Whether running on the edge of exhaustion after a long night's patrol, or parsing increasingly unsettling intelligence about the unknown substance his crew had been sent to uncover, his composure never faltered. He sustained morale with jokes that toed the line between levity and gallows humor, refusing to surrender the spark in his eye or the spring in his step.

Nothing got past Sandrine Ousset. A decorated sharpshooter before being recruited for a secretive armored reconnaissance mission, her eagle eye extended beyond the scope of her rifle. Show her a distorted fragment of enemy intelligence, and she could draw conclusions so consistently accurate that even her own crew initially mistook her uncanny observational skills for clairvoyance. Under her command, secrets rarely stayed buried for long. Fortunately for her team, she reserved her most relentless scrutiny for the source of the unknown reagent they had been sent to investigate.

"Looks like you're stuck on the shores of Hell. The only way out is through." Flynn Taggart, imprisoned within the United Aerospace Corporation's Phobos military base after repeated disregard of orders and striking his commanding officer. When UAC facility experiments opened a gateway to Hell, Taggart escaped confinement only to come face to face with Hell's army. He responded the only way he knew how: by shooting at it repeatedly. Outnumbered, defiant, and thoroughly unimpressed, the only thing standing between the apocalypse and earth was this lone marine.

"They are rage. Brutal, without mercy. But you... you will be worse." Years of battle against the forces of Hell turned Doomguy from a space marine into something altogether more... legendary. Fueled by a seething, bottomless hatred of demonkind, he has defied the limits of mortality itself, carrying his crusade deep into the infernal dimension. Much to the concern of its remaining inhabitants, the slaughter continues unabated. Slayer by name and slayer by nature, he is a man of few words. In fact, he needs only three: RIP AND TEAR!

"Hear me, Slayer. When his heart is laid to rest, then his soul will be at peace, and so will mine." Valen was one of the Night Sentinels' most revered commanders, leading countless campaigns against the forces of Hell. After his son was slain in battle, grief left the once-proud warrior susceptible to the demons' deception. The Hell Priest Deag Grav claimed he could return Valen's kin, were he to betray his order. Desperate to end his son's suffering, he unwittingly condemned Argent D'Nur, setting in motion one of the greatest tragedies they would ever endure.

"You must understand. Our interest in their world was purely for the betterment of mankind." Even with a world overrun by demons, visionary scientist Samuel Hayden refused to let a little apocalypse stand in the way of progress. He sought to extract power from the underworld itself in the form of Argent Energy to solve Earth's energy crisis. When his mortal body began to fail, he cast aside his dying flesh by transferring his consciousness into a cybernetic shell. Upon Hell's invasion of Mars, Hayden's superior intellect became humanity's greatest hope.

"We will always be a people of faith, but we must consider now who we will put that faith in. And I say to you, there is no better place to turn to than ourselves." Royal heir, mystic, and leader of the Night Sentinels, Commander Thira is equally versed in the arts of warfare and statecraft. Standing alongside the Doom Slayer in defense of her homeworld against the legions of Hell, the mysterious gift bestowed upon her through ancient Wraith magic awakens. As forgotten powers stir within her, fleeting visions reveal long-buried truths that may prove vital to the fate of her people.

People are always asking if I know Jack Reed. Before I answer, I usually take a deep breath and close my eyes for a moment. Being his commander is not a bed of roses. Reed is a rebel who somehow manages to follow orders and stay within the rules imposed by the military. Right now, he's trapped in a hot-as-hell tank. But deep inside, he's hitting the road so that he can ride his bike down Route 66 and feel the wind in his hair.

An experienced, smart, and sensible combat officer who prefers taking the logical option over the emotional one. He easily adapts to any situation and he always follows his orders wherever they may lead him, whether it is to a garrison in the Arctic Circle or a military base in the sands of North Africa. He enjoys hockey and spearfishing, although it is getting harder and harder to find the time for it.

Badaev's comrades sometimes think that he doesn't have any sense of self-preservation. He recklessly volunteers to participate in any undertaking thrown at him. He says that life without adventure is unimaginably boring, and you've got to have some stories to tell your grandchildren someday.

The commander of an expedition to Antarctica, this disciplined and well-trained soldier's only priority is to successfully complete the mission. However, under the guise of a hard-boiled military man, there is a kind-hearted person who takes care of his people.

Impeccable training and a good upbringing always help Barton keep his cool, even when his "primary irritant," Badaev, is somewhere close by. However, these two commanders have become good friends and colleagues. You won't make it long during wartime without acting as a team.

A French mechanic who worked in a car repair shop in Dijon before the war. A member of the Resistance responsible for resupplying and maintaining hardware, such as armaments and even captured German tanks. Always glad to participate in any crazy undertaking if there is a chance to improve his knowledge of vehicles.

An impulsive and active woman who demonstrated outstanding performance in battle training. Considers herself a descendant of the noble Chodkiewicz family, so she spends a lot of time studying history, especially everything related to the Polish army of the 16th and 17th centuries. She is sure that it is impossible to build modern strategies without taking the lessons of the past into account (even when considering new developments).

An American tanker. Fought on the Western Front and took part in the liberation of Paris. In late 1944, he received an agent background and completes missions for American intelligence in Argentina where he searches for signs of German presence. He speaks Spanish and easily adapts to new environments. He dreams of "finishing here as soon as possible" and returning to his son Jack, who he has never really met because of the war.

With his brother Jean-Marc, he started his tour of duty in the Resistance. He was seriously injured and lucky to be alive, but he never lost his phenomenal combat skills, even after a long recovery period. He was glad to get back on track and throw himself into another dangerous adventure. The one thing he regretted was that he and his brother were assigned to different detachments.

An MI6 staff officer. She was constantly getting into discussions with her superiors, trying to prove that wars could not be won in dusty offices. As a result, she was assigned to an Antarctic expedition with the most severe of field conditions. And that was all she needed: There's no better way to sort out and solve a problem than to face it.

A tank officer and battalion commander. He had excellent combat skills and an intuition that always helped him get out of seemingly hopeless situations. He tried to learn enemy methods and habits to hit them in their weak spots. His military cunning and prudence helped him lead his soldiers to victory, even when outnumbered.

Calm, cool, and carefree—this is how you might feel when talking to this laidback (and mildly conceited albeit undoubtedly talented) serviceman. Irony and sarcasm are his main companions, and everybody in his unit at this point knows that he is only in the army because he lost a bet to his friends back home. However, he always sees boundaries that should not be crossed, and he always acts composed and professional when needed.

Thanks to a rich library in her parents' home, one can say that, since early childhood, she traveled to all sorts of worlds created by literary classics—from Homer to Robert Howard. In the evenings, if there is opportunity, she likes to go over the events of the day in her head, trying to construct elegant and eloquent sentences. She believes it helps keep the mind sharp during service.

An experienced serviceman and former cavalry. A true professional you can set your watch by—German punctuality and discipline can be seen in his every action. He knows his strengths well, does not look for trouble or take risks, and protests any deviation from the plan. Well educated, he can hold his own in almost any conversation. Afraid of spiders.

Graduate of the Military Armored Forces Academy who unexpectedly discovered in himself an artistic talent that he is successfully developing in rare moments of respite from the service. In his satchel is a whole bunch of pencils, friendly caricatures of his comrades, landscapes, and still moments of frontline life.

A competent, reliable, and level-headed officer, Lieutenant Thassius now serves in the Ultramarines 2nd Company. He has directed Impulsor units in the field for decades, putting into practice the teachings of the Codex Astartes. These years have honed his tactical skills and he is adept at breaking through enemy defenses with extreme efficiency.

A Champion in one of the Death Guard's elite units known as the 'Poxmongers'. He is an implacable warrior and, when Nurgle allows it, he wallows slothfully in the blessings his Grandfather’s gifts. He always rises to the occasion when he is presented with the opportunity to frustrate the efforts of his loyalist enemies. He is driven by pure spite and can be counted on to accomplish his mission against the Ultramarines. In the pursuit of victory, he has been known to use the most… unimaginable methods.

A reckless Mekboy who is always in pursuit of two things: more speed and more dakka. Anything that does not contribute to those two commodities he tends to ignore. He knows enemy vehicles very well, considering them not as threats but rather as objects of possible looting to get more speed and more dakka!

He views himself as one of Nurgle's favorites, but arguably rates himself too highly. He will use any means, including blunt force, in an effort to prove his loyalty to his patron God if he thinks the methods will further his pursuit of favor. His ambition and a fanatical desire to gain approval could be considered negative qualities, but they have been paying off so far.

A Battle Sister of significant prowess. She fervently dedicated herself to her pious duties from an early age and felt her calling to fight in the Emperor's name while still a student at her Schola Progenium. More recently a localized Warp storm has delayed her arrival at the latest field of battle, leaving her frustrated at being unable to do the Emperor's will. She considers it as a mark of eternal shame. A fervent zealot, she seeks redemption in any battle where her Order—and her bolter and war machine—sees fit to attend.

By a happy coincidence of circumstances, she took command of a tank, which was built with money raised on a collective farm where her father is the chairman. She now considers it a matter of honor to fully master this vehicle and unleash its potential so that the work of hundreds of people is not wasted.

Known as Mademoiselle Ice, she is cold-blooded, prudent, almost emotionless. She never makes decisions in a hurry and always works out all the possible outcomes and consequences with mathematical precision. She could be an excellent staff officer but believes that you cannot see the whole picture of a battle from the rear.

A journalist for a London-based periodical who needs to be personally present, in the center of events, experiencing everything that is going on for better quality and more objective material. By some miracle, she forged her way and became a tank commander, now writing about her emotions and first-hand experiences. Many years later, this approach would be called "gonzo journalism."

This real-life combat officer has suffered countless battle wounds throughout his years of service. How he's remained unbroken and battle ready after all this time remains a mystery. Even in official documents, he refuses to use his real name, Mancini. Instead, he prefers to go by an alias he chose himself to reflect his incredible luck.

A uniquely contradictory officer. On the one hand, he's a real master of his trade and boasts excellent training. However, on the other, he wholeheartedly despises anything and everything related to war and military service. This likely has something to do with his family history, but he doesn't talk about it much. And everyone knows better than to ask him about it.

This former actress once played a tank commander in a mid-budget film. However, her dedication to the role inspired her to undergo such intensive military training that she was later able to abandon her unstable acting career and enter military service. The work was more fulfilling and it brought great pride to her father, who served in the Normandie-Niemen Fighter Regiment.

One of the autonomous anthropomorphous endoskeleton mechanism models created by Cyberdyne Systems (designation: CSM-101) to perform combat missions. The machine's processor, which works in expanded mode, is able to learn, providing a considerable advantage in case mission parameters change. The T-800 is considered the most effective (and most iconic) specimen out of the entire range of terminators.

A 10-year-old boy and the future leader of a global resistance movement in the war between machines and humans. The main enemy of Skynet. To eliminate him, the network sent its most advanced creation: the T-1000. However, knowing Skynet's plans, the future John Connor decided to protect himself by sending a reprogrammed T-800 machine to the past, which completed the mission and eliminated the threat to the (then non-existent, but still very important) future resistance.

John Connor's mother. She knows about his destiny and prepares him for his role as the future resistance leader. Her attempts to tell the world about the future forced her into isolation, which put the whole of humanity under immense threat. However, even in captivity, she remained strong in spirit. After being reunited with her son and his unlikely protector, she continued the battle against Skynet. One of the most memorable female characters in cinema.

The newest and most advanced (at the time) terminator model, which was created by Skynet to eliminate John Connor. Unlike older endoskeletons, it consists of liquid metal alloy that is capable of shape shifting and mimicry to blend in with its environment. It is not susceptible to mechanical destruction, and basically invulnerable to firearms. Despite being mass-produced in the future, it was used very rarely. In fact, Skynet considered the cutting-edge self-learning chip a potential threat to the network.

The leader of Shu Han's Five Tiger Generals. A red-faced warrior with a dignified air who stands at a height of nine chi, Guan Yu was widely known for his loyalty, righteousness, benevolence, and bravery. Having sworn to face all hardship with his sworn brothers, he valued his lord over any fame or wealth. Both a brave fighter and a cultured scholar, he would be hailed by later generations for his many virtues.

Guan Yu's eldest son. Brave and strong since childhood, he inherited his father's qualities of loyalty and righteousness, becoming a patriot who would risk his life to defend his state. Following his father into battle, he performed numerous heroic deeds and intimidated enemies with his valor. Later generations respectfully call him "Lord Guan's Son" and worship both him and his father, passing down their legends.

Guan Yu's second son. Discovered at the age of 20 by the Prime Minister, he held the high-ranking positions of Palace Attendant and Middle Military Inspector. Just like his father, he was brave and skillrful in wars, and became one of the leading generals in late Shu Han. He made significant contributions to various northward expeditions and, though his life was cut short at a young age, his reputation as a loyal and brave warrior has endured through the ages.
Legend says he was a son of Guan Yu. Stationed in Yunnan, Guan So became widely known for his heroism.

With his remarkable strength and giant build, Zhou Cang was first a subordinate of the Yellow Turban rebel leader Zhang Bao before he became Guan Yu's bodyguard. When Guan Yu attended a meeting armed with only a blade, Zhou Cang accompanied him and carried his blade. Brave and strong, he caught Pang De in the water. Forever loyal to Guan Yu, he took his own life after learning his lord was no more. He would later be honored as General Weining and the Marquis of Wulie, and worshipped alongside Guan Yu.

Guan Yu's daughter. Born in an era of great unrest, Guan YinPing learned the essence of martial arts from her father at a young age, and by 18 was a superb fighter. When Jingzhou fell, she returned to Chengdu and joined Liu Bei's forces before accompanying the Prime Minister on his southward expedition. She married Li Wei, the son of Shu general Li Hui, and settled in Yuyuan, bringing prosperity to the area. Though her life story was mostly passed down through folklore, Guan YinPing's image as a woman of valor means she has been revered throughout the centuries.

The leader of the Six Sages and Erlang Shen's top general. Born with divine strength, he wields a crescent-moon spade. He is a calm, resolute strategist who commands the army. As Erlang Shen's most trusted confidant, he is consulted on all major decisions. He assisted in subduing the Min River and splitting Peach Mountain. During the Siege of Mount Huaguo, he blocked the escape routes and helped capture the Great Sage.

The second sage, known as Commander Zhang. He wields a brilliant silver spear with dragon-like speed. Possessing a deep hatred for evil, he is always the first to lead the charge. He suppressed the demons of the Seventy-Two Caves and slew a thousand-year-old flood dragon in the Min River. During the Investiture of the Gods and the campaign against the Monkey King, his bravery in battle earned him a fearsome reputation across the realm.

The third sage, Commander Li. A man of immense physical stature and infinite strength, he favors the spiked mace. Known for his steady composure, he never wavers in the heat of battle. He assisted Erlang Shen to clear paths and was the first to break through the gates of the Water Curtain Cave at Mount Huaguo.

The fourth sage, Commander Yao. He wields dual hooks with lightning speed and unpredictable technique. Fierce yet sharp-witted, he often serves among the vanguard. Having followed Erlang Shen on numerous campaigns, his valor during the Investiture of the Gods and the siege of the Monkey King was so great that demons fled at the sight of him.

The fifth sage, General Guo. He is exceptionally agile, wielding his staff so quickly that it becomes a blur. His movements are like lightning, and his strikes carry the force of a thunderclap. As a man of integrity who honors his word, he excels at scouting and ambushing, often venturing deep into demon dens to gather intelligence for Erlang Shen.

The sixth sage, General Zhi, serves as Erlang Shen's personal bodyguard. His prowess in archery is superb, drawing his bow like a full moon and firing arrows like falling stars. No less brave than his brothers, he is straightforward, charismatic, and fiercely loyal. During the battle at Mount Huaguo, he fought side-by-side with Erlang Shen and personally captured several monkey generals.

The daughter of anti-fascist scientists from Dresden, Leni was left alone when her parents were arrested and disappeared in concentration camps during the war. Finding refuge in the underground resistance, she underwent combat training and quickly became a highly skilled sniper and spy. As hostilities raged, Leni orchestrated sabotage operations, eliminated high-ranking officers, and gathered intelligence for the Allies. Even when the war ended, she continued her pursuit of justice, hunting former Nazis with special units—and attracting the interest of Sector 3, who brought her into their ranks.

Growing up in a blacksmith's family in a small Czech town, Miroslav was no stranger to physical labor from a young age—and learned early on that strength wasn't just about hard work, but about responsibility, too. When Czechoslovakia fell under occupation, he put his skills to use in the resistance movement, using his strength and engineering expertise to organize sabotage plots. After the war, he played a key role in rebuilding Czechoslovakia's tank industry—before finding a new outlet for his talents in Sector 3.

Born into a military family in Virginia, Corvin was raised in an environment of discipline and exacting standards. His outstanding analytical mind led him first to West Point, where he graduated magna cum laude, then across the Atlantic to the North African and European theaters of World War II. Throughout the war, his unconventional strategic thinking and composure under pressure set him apart, whether as an intelligence officer or unit commander. After the war, he continued to serve in the U.S. Army's analytics department, where his remarkable track record caught the attention of Sector 3.

Raised in a family of Bernese watchmakers, Stefan inherited a craft that demanded silence, patience, and absolute control. But for him, those qualities would define a very different career. In 1940, British intelligence offered him a choice: neutral Switzerland on one side of the border, him on the other. In the Alpine passes, he grew from espionage device mechanic to marksman. After the war, he continued that work, eliminating those who had escaped justice under false names. Stefan always worked alone, without leaving a trace, and still does: no one in Sector 3 has ever seen his face.
Awarded during particular game events. Female crew members have the Brothers in Arms perk trained to 100%, as well as one more perk of your choice trained to 100%.

TalkToMeGoose, an illustrious commander with a passion for tanks, is now your wingman in World of Tanks! Known for his dedication, friendliness, and enthusiasm, TalkToMeGoose is a World of Tanks veteran ready to lead your crew to a phenomenal victory!

Skieeeel AKA Skill4ltu, the baboon king, the legend, the master of bananas, and a masterful World of Tanks commander, steps onto the battlefield to stand by your side. With a rich history in the game, the king baboon himself is ready to lead your crew to triumph.

Whisper the name Roberto Montagna in the ear of any footballer and watch their eyes widen in terror. A stalwart of the Tigers' midfield for the past decade, his passion and never-say-die attitude have won him the adoration of fans and the dread of opponents, who'll do anything it takes to avoid his bone-crunching tackles.
It's not just the opposition he has fearing for their legs, though. If you're on Montagna's team and having a bad match, or you’re a referee whose decisions he deems "questionable", well...you either up your game fast or prepare for the dressing-room dressing-down of your life.

In Billy Trotter's day, football wasn't for the faint-hearted. The ball was heavier, the tackles were harder, and the pitches were more battlefields than sporting venues. But Billy had served his country with valor in the war, and none of that was going to faze him. The trickiest winger of the time, he would dance past defenders in a blaze of black and orange, leaving them seeing double before firing a rocket of a shot into the top corner.
Precious little footage remains of Billy plying his trade for the Tigers. But his name still echoes around the terraces at every home game.
An effective commander who can raise the morale of the entire crew.
Fighting for Uncle Sam, this commander is ready for combat thanks to his three additional perks.
He might be missing an eye, but "Nelson" is more than equipped for battle thanks to his perks.
A commander of the people, "Ferdi" knows how to drive panzers in World of Tanks.
A true mercenary, Alex "The Hunter" Duke is just in it for the thrill of the fight.
A skilled veteran with international experience, Kharlamov is a leader any crew could dream of.
If you need a commander to bring that Holiday feel to battle, Angela Di Natale is the go-to expert who will provide just the right amount of fireworks and explosions.
Henri's tactical beard has been groomed to increase his crew's bravery and bring victory, which it does on a regular basis—around 5 times out of 10.

An outstanding German engineer. Designer of advanced armaments and defense systems based on harvesting electricity and completely controlling it. One of the pioneers of robotics who believes that the main load in modern conflicts must fall onto machines rather than their operators.

An experienced commander and mechanic who is very familiar with the equipment provided by the Alliance. He is formally considered the leader of the operation but does not single himself out—he believes that success depends on everyone working together, as well as the personal initiative of every person on the team. He is sure that well-executed and well-timed improvisation can salvage any situation, even when something goes completely wrong.

A graduate of the N Cave, which is a special Alliance combat training department responsible for finding and capturing (or recovering) valuable technology for further research under the authority of the organization. She is very respectful of von Krieger's activities but believes that both he and his technology belong within the Alliance's walls.

Real name and biographical details unknown. Nationality is only assumed, as well. Obviously, the Alliance wouldn't sign up just anybody for such a crucial operation, but the fact that the identity of this tanker is unknown even to their team raises many suspicions and speculations.

Max von Krieger's daughter. This talented robotics engineer was among the first to successfully integrate artificial intelligence into the controls system of a heavy vehicle. She does everything in her power to keep her father's secrets and breakthrough inventions out of the Alliance's hands.

The commander of the Alliance's battle wing, and an old personal acquaintance of von Krieger. Although she does not consider her old Steel Hunter partner an enemy of humanity (like some of the higher-ups in the Alliance's do), she's determined to put an end to his family's dangerous games before their electric experiments spin out of control.

Fresh from the academy, this commander is eager to prove her skill in battle. She trained in cavalry-style battlefield maneuvers and is used to surveying the battlefield carefully to use it to her advantage. Although lacking experience, she is a master of several new technologies and battle techniques and might just teach the old dogs some new tricks.

Despite being Ermelinda's sister, Hannelore is her exact opposite. A strategic mastermind, she joined the Harriers to prevent her evil sister from making irreparable mistakes. She still believes that Ermelinda can be saved and will do anything to put her on the right track.
Surprise! Oh, I'm back. And I'll show my mastery and iron will once more!
Fighting the infamous Max von Krieger...
Never thought the day would come...
This directionless world needs me more than ever.
战争是一门艺术，而我则赋予了艺术灵魂！
修理是我的乐趣，但摧毁更让我兴奋！
麦克斯韦赐予我力量，高斯指引我方向！
懦夫的气息，注定了你是我的猎物！
This fractured world still resists order. Very well. I shall bring it structure…again.
I don’t care what it is—loop, dream, or trap. We adapt, we fight.
This isn’t time repeating—it’s something pretending to be.
The more this loop repeats, the less I play by its rules. Even time can’t catch me.
This loop won’t outsmart me. I'm not just surviving it—I'm learning from it.
Yana is a versatile tank combat specialist, who can perform any role in the crew equally well. She is stress-resistant, a quick learner, and a true team player.
The captain of this flourishing tank team. Calm, funny, and able to make sound judgments on the battlefield, he's the backbone of the team.
The youngest hare in the team. He brings more vitality to the team, but he lacks battlefield experience. There are still many things for him to learn.
A gunner who gets the job done better than most. On the battlefield, she loves nothing more than showing 'em who's boss.
He has a simple and honest personality and likes all kinds of food. He can adjust the atmosphere and mood of the team easily.
The oldest hare on the team. Although he has reached middle age, his stamina and energy remain as high as ever.
